Terpenoid and flavonoid biosynthesis pathways and their regulatory network in A

Terpenoid and flavonoid biosynthesis pathways and their regulatory network in A. roxburghii. Flavonoid biosynthesis pathway derived from phenylpropanoid metabolism. Terpenoid biosynthesis pathway, including the MVA and MEP pathways converging at IPP and DMAPP. The color scale represents relative gene expression levels under the conventional tissue culture group (CK) and the sugar-free tissue culture group (TD) conditions based on log2-transformed values, ranging from blue (low) to red (high)
